summary: Generates tubes, cones, or pyramids along a chosen axis as primitive, polygon, mesh, NURBS, or Bezier geometry with caps, UVs, and normals.

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Primitive, polygon, mesh, NURBS, or Bezier output.

key_params.name: surftype
key_params.note: Connectivity for mesh output such as rows, columns, triangles, or quads.

key_params.name: orient
key_params.note: Primary long axis for the tube.

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Enable transforms that modify input bounds.

key_params.name: imperfect
key_params.note: Approximate Bezier or NURBS tube instead of perfect rational curve.

common_gotchas: The Primitive output type is not recommended for instancing workflows.
Different top and bottom radii create cones or pyramids; zero radii can collapse cap geometry.
Rows and Columns connectivity can create open line-like polygon structures rather than closed quads.
Bounds-driven tubes need an input SOP and explicit Orient Bounds or Modify Bounds settings.
Texture Coordinates text mentions sphere on the official page, but the parameter still belongs to Tube SOP UV generation.
key_concepts: Tube SOP creates tubes, cones, or pyramids along a chosen X, Y, or Z axis.
Output can be a primitive, polygon, mesh, NURBS, or Bezier surface, with mesh connectivity controlling row, column, triangle, or quad structure.
Different top and bottom radii shape cylinders, cones, and pyramids.
Input bounds can orient and size the tube, then Modify Bounds enables center, rotation, radius, and height edits.
